data.title: Doctor faces probe over 'low class' jibe
data.description: <p>A Bangkok doctor accused of threatening a kidney patient and describing beneficiaries of the 30-baht universal healthcare scheme as "low-class people" faces an investigation by the Ministry of Public Health.</p>

data.title: Sondhi planning street mobilisation
data.description: <p>Political tensions are mounting as veteran protest leader Sondhi Limthongkul prepares to announce a street mobilisation campaign, prompting Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul to warn that demonstrations must follow the law.</p>

data.title: Parit queried on sources of leaked report
data.description: <p>People's Party MP Parit Wacharasindhu was questioned on Thursday by a House committee on police affairs about the sources of information he cited in allegations of collusion in the Senate election.</p>

data.title: 'Fake father' scheme poses security risk, panel warns
data.description: <p>The House Committee on Public Health has urged authorities to step up investigations into "fake father" networks, warning that foreigners fraudulently registered as Thai could eventually gain the right to own property and enter politics.</p>

data.title: BMA stepping  up checks on  Chabad houses
data.description: <p>The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) is stepping up inspections of Chabad house facilities in Bangkok amid concerns over their expansion in areas popular with Israeli tourists and foreign residents.</p>

data.title: Australia eyes drug production potential
data.description: <p>Australia is exploring Thailand as a potential manufacturing base and regional hub for complementary medicines, as Australian businesses seek to expand investment and long-term cooperation.</p>

data.title: Court talks address online crime
data.description: <p>The Criminal Court has brought together police, banks, the media and the Anti-Money Laundering Office (Amlo) to discuss ways to tackle online crime, which the court says now accounts for over half of its cases.</p>

data.title: Call-centre scams cost retirees billions
data.description: <p>Cyber police have warned retirees and older people about call-centre scams after losses among victims aged 60 and above reached 3.15 billion baht in eight months.</p>

data.title: Saysunee and Chitiphat lead home charge
data.description: <p>The Thai wheelchair fencing team claimed two gold, one silver and two bronze medals at the 2026 Para Fencing World Cup Pattaya at the National Eastern Sports Centre in Chon Buri.</p>

data.title: Buriram eye repeat, foes scramble
data.description: <p>In every competition there are contenders, and there are pretenders. Increasingly, though, Thai League 1 looks like one of the rare leagues anywhere that can also boast a permanent winner.</p>

data.title: Hugging Face, the French start-up that became AI's warehouse
data.description: NEW YORK - Hugging Face, the artificial intelligence platform US chip giant Nvidia is buying for $12.9 billion, is a French success story -- founded by three Frenchmen and incubated in Paris -- even if its headquarters and many of its investors are American.

data.title: Parliament  rejects air bill changes
data.description: <p>The House of Representatives has rejected Senate amendments to the Clean Air Management Bill, voting instead to set up a joint committee to reconsider changes that MPs say would weaken pollution controls.</p>

data.title: How El Nino is choking the Panama Canal
data.description: PANAMA CITY - The Panama Canal will restrict the number of vessels transiting the crucial waterway from Friday for the second time ever due to drought caused by the El Nino climate phenomenon.

data.title: Zelensky hopes to host US envoys in Kyiv in 'coming days'
data.description: KYIV (UKRAINE) - Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said Thursday he hoped to host US President Donald Trump's envoys in Kyiv in the coming days to resume efforts to end the Russian invasion.

data.title: Ahead of elections, Israel tests West's patience on West Bank violence
data.description: JERUSALEM - Israel's ties with many Western allies were already fraught over its conduct in the Gaza war, but the worsening situation in the occupied West Bank has seen relations nosedive before close-fought October elections.

data.title: Volkswagen says cutting 100,000 jobs by end of decade
data.description: FRANKFURT (GERMANY) - German car giant Volkswagen said Thursday that management and unions had agreed to cut a total of 100,000 jobs by the end of the decade, the biggest-ever restructuring in the global auto industry.

data.title: Russia slaps curfew on charity director over army criticism
data.description: MOSCOW - A Russian court on Thursday imposed a curfew and communications blackout on the head of a children's hospice accused of spreading "false information" about the army, as Moscow cracks down on critics of its Ukraine offensive.

data.title: Iran war is not a war, US VP Vance says
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - US Vice President JD Vance said Thursday he would not categorize the Iran war as a war, despite continuing clashes with Tehran six months after the start of the conflict.

data.title: Spanish PM says no 'solid proof' Morocco planned Ceuta migrant rush
data.description: MADRID - Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez on Thursday insisted there was no "solid proof" Morocco orchestrated July's migrant rush into Ceuta, after a police report alleged failings by Moroccan security forces.

data.title: Venezuela's Maduro seeks immunity from US drug charges
data.description: NEW YORK - Venezuela's ousted leader Nicolas Maduro and his wife have asked a US judge to dismiss drug trafficking charges against them, claiming they have immunity as president and first lady of a sovereign country.

data.title: 'No plans to retire', says 'acting god' Malkovich
data.description: VENICE - American actor John Malkovich said Thursday he had no plans to retire, speaking ahead of the premiere of his latest film, dark comedy "Wild Horse Nine" set in 1970s Chile.

data.title: Ukraine, India discuss Black Sea, food security on FM's 'historic' Kyiv visit
data.description: KYIV (UKRAINE) - Indian Foreign Minister Subrahmanyam Jaishankar arrived in Kyiv on Thursday to discuss shipping in the Black Sea and food security, Ukraine's authorities said.

data.title: US feminist icon Gloria Steinem passes at 92
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - American journalist, activist and feminist icon Gloria Steinem has died, her foundation said on Thursday. She was 92.

data.title: Nigerian opposition lobbyist tapped for White House-linked role, firm says
data.description: ABUJA - A US lobbying firm working for a Nigerian opposition leader said one of its top employees was appointed to a White House commission, ahead of presidential elections in Africa's most populous country.

data.title: Grief on Chinese internet as wait for Tibet flood news drags on
data.description: BEIJING - Photos of sons, daughters, uncles and husbands have peppered Chinese social media, shared by people hoping for news about relatives missing since deadly floods on the border with Nepal last week.

data.title: Putin denies plan for new Russia military call up
data.description: MOSCOW — Russia has no present need to mobilise more men for its Ukraine offensive, President Vladimir Putin said Thursday, describing speculation about another military call-up as Ukrainian "disinformation".

data.title: Caruana Galizia: 'one-woman WikiLeaks' who exposed Malta's shady side
data.description: VALLETTA - Illicit trafficking, bribes, offshore accounts: Maltese journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia, murdered with a car bomb in 2017, fearlessly exposed corruption in her archipelago in the heart of the Mediterranean.

data.title: Thai lawmaker gets messages of support from Myanmar citizens after protest
data.description: A Thai opposition lawmaker who drew wide attention for disrupting his country's official welcome of Myanmar military chief-turned-President Min Aung Hlaing last month said he received many messages from Myanmar citizens supporting his action, which he said was meant as a protest against military rule.

data.title: Seating collapse halts Thai rockers’ farewell show
data.description: Music fans attending a farewell concert by the legendary Thai rock band Asanee & Wasan were sent home before they could even say their goodbyes after part of a temporary elevated VIP seating structure collapsed.

data.title: Kuwait's Iranians under pressure since start of war
data.description: KUWAIT CITY — A Persian restaurant in Kuwait has removed any mention of Iran from its name, a sign of the pressure the Iranian community in the Gulf country has faced since the Middle East war erupted.

data.title: Outrage mounts in Malta after acquittal over journalist's murder
data.description: VALLETTA — Hundreds of people demonstrated in the Maltese capital Valletta after a wealthy businessman was found not guilty of masterminding the murder of an investigative journalist.

data.title: EU lawmakers demand Brussels force Meta to 'protect' children
data.description: BRUSSELS — European lawmakers demanded that the European Union (EU) executive force Meta to change the "addictive" design of its platforms in Europe, as the giant has promised to do in some US states, according to a letter seen by Agence France-Presse ( AFP ) on Thursday.

data.title: Delivering aid to Nepal flood survivors 'very, very difficult': UN
data.description: KATHMANDU (NEPAL) - Reaching survivors of Nepal's devastating floods has bee an immense challenge with the delivery of basic aid supplies hampered, the United Nations explained Thursday, considering the use of cargo drones and porters in addition to destroyed roads.

data.title: Three hurt in explosion at Samut Prakan factory
data.description: Three workers were injured when a machine exploded inside a car-seat factory in Bang Bo district of Samut Prakan province on Thursday afternoon.

data.title: Sansiri launches fund to acquire Italian luxury hotel asset
data.description: Sansiri Capital plans to acquire 100% of The Lake Como EDITION in Italy, a luxury hotel asset valued at more than EUR200 million.

data.title: From distributor to shareholder: Banobagi's Thai success story
data.description: MsMean — Yosaporn Suwanwichian, CEO of Beyond Beauty Trade Co Ltd, a leading importer and distributor of beauty products — has gone beyond simply being an importer. She successfully introducedBanobagifacial masks to the Thai market, securing the position of Watsons' best-selling facial mask for seven consecutive years.

data.title: Feminist trailblazer Gloria Steinem dies at age 92
data.description: ⁠The trailblazing American feminist ⁠activist ​and ​journalist Gloria ‌Steinem has died at the age ​92, her ​foundation said ⁠on Thursday.

data.title: Hender Scheme and Artek releases shoes for stools
data.description: From being fashion’s favoured stool to now getting its own pair of shoes, Artek’s iconic Finnish-designed Stool 60 is getting a new look through a collaboration collection with Japanese leather artisan brand Hender Scheme.
